evidence: Home page shows 6 template cards, each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card displays title, category badge (e.g. Resume), scenario badge (e.g. Business), description, author, usage count (e.g. 1,250 uses), and updated date (e.g. Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened a dialog with template details (title, category, scenario, description, author, uses) and a Fill Template form with Preview Result tab.

With no fields filled, an alert lists 'Required fields missing: Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills' and the Preview Result tab is disabled (click attempt timed out because element not enabled).

All 14 fields of Professional Resume template (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, StartDate, EndDate, Responsibilities, Degree, School, GraduationYear, Skills) were fillable and retained entered values.

After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and rendered a resume with all entered values substituted (Jane Doe, Software Engineer, jane.doe@example.com, Tech Corp — Senior Developer, etc.).
Preview Result tab was disabled (click timed out, element not enabled) when fields were empty, and became clickable/active only after all required fields were filled.

Preview rendered Markdown correctly: H1 name heading, bold job title, separator line, H2 section headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), H3 sub-heading, italic date range, and all placeholders replaced with entered values with no leftover {{placeholder}} tokens.
Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered with proper headings, bold/italic emphasis, and separator after field substitution.
Clicking Copy to Clipboard triggered a toast notification 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.'

issue: No format validation for declared-format fields (email)
actual: Entering an invalid email value 'not-an-email' into the required Email field did not block the preview or show any validation error; the Preview Result tab remained enabled and rendered 'not-an-email' directly into the output text.

evidence: Typing '# Jane *Doe* [Link](javascript:alert(1)) <script>alert(1)</script>' into Full Name showed inline error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed' and the Preview Result tab became disabled again.

Clicking the favorite toggle on Professional Resume set it to 'on', header favorites count became 1, and toggling the Favorites filter switched grid to a favorites-only view showing 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' with only Professional Resume.

Within favorites-only view, searching 'Resume' still matched the 1 favorited template, and filtering by category 'Email' correctly narrowed to 0 results with 'No favorites yet' empty state, showing search/filter works within favorites scope.

Favoriting Professional Resume set toggle 'on', header showed 'Favorites 1'; unfavoriting immediately reverted toggle to default, header reverted to 'Favorites' (no count) and favorites-only view updated to 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' / 'No favorites yet' without reload.

Typing 'Res' (3 chars) showed a suggestions list (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, In Progress, Academic Research Summary, Research Title). Clicking 'Professional Resume' filled search box with 'Professional Resume' and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

actual: Searching 'Resme' and 'Reusme' (small typos of 'Resume') both returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' / 'No templates found' with no suggestions and no matching templates, instead of returning or suggesting 'Professional Resume'.

evidence: Category filter 'Resume' narrowed to 1/6 (Professional Resume); Scenario filter 'Academic' narrowed to 1/6 (Academic Research Summary); Sort 'Alphabetical' reordered all 6 items into correct A-Z order (Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report).

Each filter/sort/favorites/search change (category, scenario, sort, favorites toggle, search text) updated 'Showing X of 6 templates' count and grid contents immediately without any page reload/navigation observed.

issue: Duplicate field labels are silently allowed with colliding placeholder keys
actual: Adding a second field with the same label 'Project Name' was accepted without any warning; both fields display identically as 'Project Name' mapping to the same placeholder '{{project_name}}', causing a key collision rather than being rejected or disambiguated.

issue: Template submission does not validate placeholder/field mapping
actual: Submitted a custom template with a declared field 'Priority Level' ({{priority_level}}) never used in content, and a content placeholder {{wrong_placeholder}} not mapped to any declared field. Submission succeeded without error, and the generated preview showed the literal unresolved text '{{wrong_placeholder}}' instead of blocking submission or resolving it.

evidence: Clicking Submit Template with all fields blank kept the dialog open with no new template created (grid remained 'Showing 6 of 6 templates'), confirming submission was blocked without required fields.

Submit Template dialog accepted Title, Author, Description, Category, Scenario, Markdown-toggled Content, and at least one defined field (Project Name), and successfully created 'QA Custom Template' upon clicking Submit Template.
After submission, 'QA Custom Template' immediately appeared in the grid ('Showing 7 of 7 templates') by author QA Bot, and could be opened via Use Template, filled, and previewed.
Immediately after clicking Submit Template (no reload), the grid result count updated from 'Showing 6 of 6 templates' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and the new template card was visible.

After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, the grid still shows 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' including custom 'QA Custom Template', and its favorite toggle remains 'on' with header favorites count still '1'.
